newsitem.title: USA: General Dynamics names Turner president.
newsitem.headline: General Dynamics names Turner president.

text.p: General Dynamics Corp said Thursday directors elected James Turner Jr president and chief operating officer, effective June 1.
As previously announced, the company said, Vice Chairman Nicholas Chabraja will become chairman and chief executive officer on June 1, succeeding James Mellor, who is retiring at the end of May.
Turner's new titles have not been used at General Dynamics since Mellor was named chief executive, spokeswoman Norine Lyons said.

Turner joined General Dynamics in 1988 as corporate vice president and general manager of Electric Boat, which designs and builds nuclear submarines. He was promoted to executive vice president in 1991 and named to head the company's Marine Group in 1995.
